svg.title: For each fine link e its scalar correction is P c olor z(e,j) hatted(e,j). Multiply this by aperture(e), the cone profile at twice the chosen enforcement radius on hot links and the value 1 on other links, to obtain qfirst. For an itinerary of n+2 link steps, the quadratic correction is half the bilinear pairing between its starting and ending z vectors with the ordered matrix-block product
